# Life Ledger for Mac 3.0.0

**Download:** `Life-Ledger-3.0.0-mac-arm64.zip` below (Apple Silicon: M1–M4, macOS 12 or later). Unzip it and move **Life Ledger** to Applications. The app is not notarised: the first time, open **System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway**.

## Two ways to use it

- **Local on this Mac:** no account, no setup. Records stay on this Mac.
- **Your own cloud (sync edition):** connect your own Life Ledger deployment and sign in with an email code. Records, photos, name and profile photo are the same on the Mac, in the browser and on the phone. Setup: [English](https://github.com/zubin-li/life-ledger-deep-review/blob/main/docs/macos-cloud.md) · [中文](https://github.com/zubin-li/life-ledger-deep-review/blob/main/docs/macos-cloud.zh-CN.md).

Change mode any time: **Settings → Data → Switch mode**, or **File → Switch Workspace…**. Local and cloud records are separate; use **Settings → Import & export** to bring records along.

## New in 3.0

- Sync edition with email-code sign-in (Cloudflare Access) and **File → Sign Out of Cloud**.
- Mode switch in Settings; version shown in the start window and in Settings.
- Backups and photo exports from the cloud window go to **Downloads**.
- The cloud page gets only what it needs from the app (confirm/alert sheets, menu language, mode switch), never file access.
- Includes web 2.0.4: reviews are only what you write, unified dropdowns, profile photo framing, weather in the city's local time.

## Your data

Updating from an earlier Mac build keeps your local records (same app identifier). No server of ours is involved: the sync edition talks only to your own deployment.
